hero.title: Connect Your Customer and Dealer Data Into One System.
hero.description: We integrate and customize CRM and DRM platforms, connecting your customer relationships, dealer networks, and existing business tools into one AI-assisted system, built to help you manage relationships instead of chasing scattered data.

introSection.title: Disconnected Systems Cost You More Than Time.
introSection.lead: When your customer data lives in one place, your dealer or distributor records live in another, and your sales team is working from a spreadsheet nobody trusts, decisions get slower and relationships fall through the cracks.
introSection.narrative: At FuduGo, we integrate CRM and DRM platforms directly into your existing workflows, connecting customer data, dealer relationships, and business tools into one system your team can actually rely on, backed by AI-assisted development to keep the integration reliable and secure.

capabilities.title: CRM Integration
capabilities.description: Connecting or customizing CRM platforms to match your actual sales process, not a generic pipeline template.

capabilities.title: DRM Integration
capabilities.description: Dealer and distributor relationship systems that keep your network data centralized, accurate, and easy to manage.

capabilities.title: Third-Party & API Integration
capabilities.description: Connecting your CRM/DRM to the other tools you already use, including payment systems, marketing platforms, and internal databases.

capabilities.title: Data Migration & Sync
capabilities.description: Moving existing customer and dealer data into your new or integrated system without losing accuracy or history.

aiDevelopment.title: How AI Makes Your CRM & DRM Smarter
aiDevelopment.lead: We use AI-enabled development tools as part of our everyday build process, and where it adds real value, we build AI into the integration itself, not as a gimmick, but as a working part of how your team manages relationships.

items.title: Plain-Language Data Queries
items.description: Instead of digging through reports, your team can ask a direct question, like "Which dealers had the biggest drop in orders this quarter?", and get an AI-generated answer pulled directly from your connected data.

items.title: Automatic Relationship Insights
items.description: Our AI-assisted dashboards can surface patterns, such as at-risk customer accounts or underperforming dealer regions, without manual report-building.

items.title: Faster, More Reliable Integration
items.description: The same AI-assisted coding practices we use across every project, including continuous best-practice checks and early security flagging, apply here too, so sensitive customer and dealer data is handled on a secure, well-tested foundation.

items.title: Cleaner Data, Automatically
items.description: AI-assisted logic can help flag duplicate or inconsistent records during integration, reducing the manual cleanup work your team would otherwise have to do by hand.

techStack.title: Built With the Right Technology.
techStack.lead: We select the right integration approach based on your existing systems, data structure, and long-term scalability needs.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.lead: Clear answers about connecting CRM, DRM, and ERP platforms safely and effectively.

items.question: What does FuduGo offer in CRM and DRM integration?
items.answer: FuduGo integrates and customizes CRM and DRM platforms, connects them to your existing business tools, and migrates existing customer and dealer data into the new system.

items.question: Can you integrate a CRM/DRM we already use, or do we need to switch platforms?
items.answer: In most cases, we can integrate and customize your existing CRM or DRM platform. Where a platform genuinely can't support what you need, we'll tell you directly rather than forcing a workaround.

items.question: Does FuduGo use AI in CRM/DRM systems?
items.answer: Yes. Where it adds real value, we build AI-powered features like plain-language data queries and automated relationship insights directly into the integration.

items.question: Will our existing customer and dealer data be safe during migration?
items.answer: Yes. We follow a structured migration process with data validation at each step, backed by the same AI-assisted security checks we use across all development.

items.question: Can this connect to other tools we use, like payment or marketing platforms?
items.answer: Yes. We regularly build integrations between CRM/DRM systems and third-party tools like payment gateways, marketing platforms, and internal databases.
